critical_blocking_issues.root_cause: Advanced 3D capture feature for greenhouse digital twin — 3 endpoints (holography register, photogrammetry register, digital-twin status) defined in tests but NOT implemented in api/routers/greenhouse.py. Tests are correct specification; implementation is incomplete.
critical_blocking_issues.blocking_what: Digital Twin 3D Capture System — Cannot register holographic or photogrammetric scan data from greenhouse prototypes P1/P2, cannot query 3D capture status. Feature entirely blocked.

models_needed: HolographyCapture (input): device_id (str), resolution (str), point_density (float), coverage_percent (float 0-100), operator_id (optional str)
HolographyRegistrationResponse (output): prototype_id (int), registered (bool), capture (dict with all input fields + registered_at timestamp)
missing_implementations.logic: Validate prototype_id exists (1 or 2), extract holography capture data, append to _PrototypeState.holography_captures list, return HolographyRegistrationResponse with status=200

models_needed: PhotogrammetryScan (input): device_id (str), images_count (int), overlap_percent (float 0-100), avg_reprojection_error (float), operator_id (optional str)
PhotogrammetryRegistrationResponse (output): prototype_id (int), registered (bool), capture (dict with all input fields + registered_at timestamp)
missing_implementations.logic: Validate prototype_id exists (1 or 2), extract photogrammetry scan data, append to _PrototypeState.photogrammetry_scans list, return PhotogrammetryRegistrationResponse with status=200

models_needed: DigitalTwinStatus (output): prototype_id (int), holography (dict{captures_total (int), last_capture_timestamp (str), avg_point_density (float)}), photogrammetry (dict{captures_total (int), last_capture_timestamp (str), avg_images_count (float)}), system_ready (bool)
missing_implementations.logic: Validate prototype_id exists, count holography captures (=captures_total), retrieve last capture timestamp, calculate avg point_density; same for photogrammetry; system_ready = (holography.captures_total >= 1 AND photogrammetry.captures_total >= 1); return DigitalTwinStatus with status=200
